notes: Static yellow steel scissor table, two separated pairs of black 30x15x2 hollow steel tubes, zinc pins/retainers, hydraulic barrel and chrome rod. Diagonal black/yellow stripes on all four vertical top edges; surface grain, restrained edge wear and cavity dirt. Top is z=720 mm, so a nominal 80 mm pallet reaches 800 mm. Base dimensions use the same Y-first convention as the top: 520Y x420X x60Z. Exactly two specified collision boxes: arms, hydraulic equipment and mounting clevises are visual only. The 620-760 mm top-surface range is configuration metadata, not an animated joint; changing height requires regenerating the linkage pose. No live movable mechanism is claimed. Mass 42 kg is an estimate because the spec gives none. Metres, Z up, front -X, common bottom-centre prop frame, applied transforms. Triangulated OBJ with normals, 30-degree split smoothing and weighted normals; nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlases with 0.01 island margins. Each opaque rigid part has one RGB8 sRGB albedo, CPU Cycles 64 DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), excluding direct illumination and highlights. Full procedural Principled PBR and original artwork are packed in source.blend. 1024-square previews: CPU Cycles 64, neutral grey, three lights, front-left above. Instance colour variation may be multiplied by 0.97-1.03 in simulation.  Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
